name: K10 Ultra Smart Watch With Sim Supported 2.1" Display, Wireless Charger And Bluetooth Connectivity Calling & Music, Fitness Tracker With 20 Different Sports Mode
description:
Design & Build:

Closure Type: Buckle

Clasp Type: Push Button Deployant Clasp

Band Material: Silicone

Case Material: Titanium

Features:

Touchscreen Display

Fitness Tracker (Step Count, Distance, Heart Rate, Blood Pressure)

Sleep Monitor

Reminders & Alarms

Notifications: Messages, Phone, Calendar

Camera & Music Control (MUSIC COMBO)

Voice Call Support

Wireless Charging

Built-in GPS with Geo-tagging

Water Resistance:

IPX4 Water-Resistant

Supported Applications:

Fitness Tracker, Alarm, GPS

Metrics Measured:

Blood Pressure, Heart Rate, Step Count, Distance

What’s in the Box:

1 x Smartwatch

1 x Strap

1 x Charger

1 x User Manual
